name: Default
shortDescription: OpenTelemetry APM for distributed traces, metrics and logs, with the Uptrace UI and OTLP ingestion, ClickHouse for telemetry, PostgreSQL for metadata and a Redis cache.

alerts.message: Sign in with UPTRACE_ADMIN_EMAIL and the generated UPTRACE_ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment variables. Uptrace re-applies the seeded account on every start, so change the password there and redeploy instead of changing it in the UI.
Send telemetry over OTLP/HTTP to https://<domain> and pass the project DSN shown in the Uptrace UI in the uptrace-dsn header. The OTLP/gRPC port 4317 is not published.
